fixture_name: A9 Ballinluig SB signage/VRS-adjacent visibility — real UK Stage 1&2 RSA (Transport Scotland OGL release)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Constrained forward visibility on an off-slip approach curve combined with shared verge space between pedestrians and entering drivers is a genuine, scheme-specific safety issue appropriate to raise at Stage 1.
justifications.evidence_grounding: EV-UK-025 provides a verbatim transcription of both the logged problem ('Curve of road and vegetation reduces forward visibility... clear passage by pedestrians') and the agreed remediation, directly anchoring the pivotal claim; EV-UK-002 is only tangential context.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly categorised as a safety_concern under GG 119 Stage 1 with no compliance question conflated into it, and the decision-log entry is treated as a remediation duty rather than a normative citation.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Actionable deliverable (extend clearance across the affected section) with measurable closure criteria (post-clearance driver sight lines, unobstructed pedestrian passage) and a handover deadline, though 'both logged problem locations' cites only one quoted location.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians are explicitly named affected road users, the scenario addresses their shared-corridor exposure, and the recommendation makes unobstructed pedestrian passage a mandatory acceptance condition.

justifications.substance: Obscured sight lines to a trunk-road off-slip terminus degrading driver awareness of the slowing requirement is a genuine safety failure at a high-speed transition and directly defeats the signage scheme's purpose.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim is supported by the verbatim decision-log quote in EV-UK-025 ('Vegetation affects views to end of slip road, reducing driver awareness of requirement to slow'), exceeding registry-citation-only grounding.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a GG 119 safety concern tied to a scheme acceptance measure, kept distinct from any compliance assertion, with no invented normative basis.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: post-clearance drive-through visibility check at design speed against the posted slowing requirement, recorded in the handover file — concrete, testable, and viable.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs are not exposed on the slip carriageway and the finding explicitly acknowledges scoping to vehicle occupants, so non-applicability is properly acknowledged.
